source_name: One2car Thailand listing snapshot (public research repository)
price_basis: Asking prices in THB, preserved from raw_price/price; no currency conversion or synthetic rows.
mileage_basis: Source mileage in km. Some values are source-normalized midpoints of listing mileage ranges, not independently verified exact odometer readings.
limitations: Third-party historical snapshot; not a live price feed.
Listing claims were not independently inspected; spot-check does not verify every vehicle.
Geographic distribution is dominated by Bangkok.
Source prices of 1/100 THB are excluded by the documented price > 1000 THB filter.
